title: Flow cover
description: The first and the last view of a Flow module: a very large title, a lead and a line of details, on the left; the backdrop's ribbons rise across the right (the backdrop variant hero).
instructions: Give the screen the backdrop variant hero. Body: a text block with the style lead (one or two sentences), then a text block with the style meta (duration, audience, version). Keep the screen title under about 50 characters. No label above the title.
